entities.name: Selina Doğan
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Selina Özuzun Doğan, aka Selina Doğan, is a Turkish politician of Armenian ethnicity who served as a member of the Turkish Parliament, between 2015 and 2018. She became one of the first Armenian members of Turkey’s parliament in decades, alongside Markar Esayan (AKP) and Garo Paylan (HDP).
